build_note: Trinity Force FIRST, every time. Q activates Spellblade AND Lightslinger simultaneously: Q-proc + Spellblade-empowered auto + second auto = 3-hit burst per ability use. Galeforce dash supplements E for gap closing. His range is short — dash in, burst, dash out. Never RFC (siege item, wrong for his kit). Never pure crit without TF.
vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards 5th — TF + Navori haste means more Q cycles which amplifies LDR value
vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces Lord Dominik's if 2+ sustain enemies — never run both
vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Galeforce if 3+ assassins/divers — keep TF core always
kit_notes: Q procs Spellblade + Lightslinger: empowered auto + second auto in one cycle. E gaps close and procs Lightslinger again. Weave: Q→auto→auto→E→auto→auto. Galeforce dash + E = two repositioning tools per fight. Never auto without a Lightslinger proc queued.
aram_specific: Short range forces aggressive positioning — ISB shield is important vs dive-heavy ARAM. Galeforce dash can escape engage or chase. TF haste reduces Q CD so you proc Lightslinger more frequently.
